summary: Iteration 10: Dashboard KPI live computation verified end-to-end. New pytest suite test_iter10_dashboard_kpi.py (18 tests) seeds temporary ZT10 items (product ZTPROD10, 15 ICS / 13 types) on 2032-03-01/02 via POST /api/items, PATCH /api/needs-grid/cell, POST /api/smt-stock + PATCH /api/smt-stock/{id}/cell, and covers Test1-7: part production delta, lamp assy independence, pct null, achievement buckets (89->lt90, 90/96->mid, 96.5/97->b96_97, 98->gt97, plan0/empty excluded, multi-ICS/multi-date aggregation), item shortage transitions via stock and via plan/actual (worst status per type, latest date wins, STD BELUM DISET), top shortage (only <=0, ascending, reorder, disappear, empty), group composition (GROUP1..6 always, latest record by date+shift order S3<S1<S2, update), and an independent pymongo reference implementation reconciled with the API for product filter, all products and single day. 18/18 pass. Regression test_iter8_needs_grid.py + test_iter9_import_dashboard.py: 64/64 pass (-n 0). Frontend: all resume-* cards, group-row-GROUP-n, top-shortage-* match API exactly after filter, page reload and logout/re-login; '-' shown for null pct/average; no NaN/Infinity; top-shortage-empty shown for empty period; silent refresh on window focus updates cards without spinner. All seeded data deleted; DB back to 618 items / 169 types / 508 with std / needs_entries=0 / smt_stock=0.

minor.issue: MONITORING chart pct mixes PLAN CUSTOMER (plan bar) with ACTUAL S3+S1+S2 (actual bar); pct can be >2000% while right Y axis domain is fixed [0,130] -> line is drawn far outside the % scale (right axis compressed to bottom, TARGET 100% line meaningless). Not part of the KPI spec but inconsistent with card A formula (plan S3+S1+S2).

Interpretation note: 'latest date' is per ics_no+type among rows that HAVE a balance/status. If the latest date in the period has no SHIFT 3 stock for an item, an older date's balance/status is used instead of treating the item as having no data. Confirm with user if intended.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid uses only type (top-shortage-{type}); multiple ICS with same TYPE produce duplicate testids (and type with spaces). Consider top-shortage-{ics_no}-{type}.

issues: % line overflows the 0-130% right axis when ratio is large; right axis labels (130%, TARGET 100%) squashed near the bottom
